plain_english_policy: Enact environmental regulations even if they are stricter than federal law.

effects.rationale: Enacting environmental regulations implies government intervention in the market to enforce compliance with stricter standards.
The policy aims to strengthen environmental protection by enacting more stringent regulations than federal law.

evidence_quote: "Enact environmental regulations even if they are stricter than federal law." - Source: Year: 2006, Section: Environment & Energy Issues, Question: Indicate which principles you support (if any) regarding the environment and energy. Option: f)
